shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head and torso
circular/disc motif on the body or field
carved relief detail on a broadly rectangular block
justification: Both depict a single dominant humanoid figure with low-relief detail and some disc/roundel motifs, but that is where the correspondence ends: A shows a bird-headed winged genie in strict profile, striding, holding a bucket and cone amid stylized rosette-plants under a band of dense inscription, while B is a frontal, massive, block-like standing figure with a broad head and headdress and sparse incised roundels and bands, with no wings, no attributes held, no vegetal field and no text register. The proportions, viewpoint (profile narrative relief vs frontal volumetric figure) and rendering conventions are entirely different, so only generic 'human-like figure and circles' is shared.
